escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real night photograph in a city plaza, epic scale, inverted scale read in two beats, the native layout of a horizontal feed and link ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the LEFT 44% of the frame, from the top edge to the bottom edge, is one continuous, evenly dark, starless overcast night sky in deep navy-black with fine grain: no light falls on it, no glow, no bokeh, no buildings, no signs and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives in the RIGHT 54% of the frame, between 14% and 84% of the frame height. The LOWEST 16% of the frame is the near-black matte edge of a concrete bench right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light. THE MOMENT: behind her, filling the band between 14% and 73% of the frame height and filling the right half of the frame, a MONUMENTAL curved LED facade on a dark building shows ONE campaign key visual of a fictitious running-shoe brand: a real photograph of an athlete frozen mid-stride on wet asphalt at dusk, wearing a vivid orange (#FF6500) jacket, shot from a low angle, with a single bold diagonal of orange light; no letters, no logo. In the foreground, in the RIGHT half of the frame, centered at about 70% of the width, a Latin American creative director in her early forties, short dark hair with a few grey strands, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 21% of the frame height, the bench cutting her at the waist, holds up her phone at chest height with her right arm fully visible: on its screen, the SAME key visual adapted as a vertical story, the same athlete and the same orange diagonal, sharp. The giant facade and the small phone show the same idea at two extreme scales. Her head is almost frontal and she looks straight into the lens with a calm, knowing half-smile. LIGHT: the facade is the only key light: it washes her from behind and the left with warm orange, and the phone screen lights her chin and hand from below; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim from a distant streetlight outlines her hair. Thin night haze in front of the facade, only in the RIGHT half of the frame. A real face: natural skin with irregular pores, fine facial hair, faint lines at the eyes, even healthy tone, no retouching, no plastic skin. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened. Real sensor grain, genuine depth of field: the facade soft but legible. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand. HORIZONTAL LIMIT (essential, checked): every person, creature, light trail, projected shape, screen, mural and prop sits entirely to the RIGHT of the vertical line at 56% of the frame width; the LEFT half of the frame shows only the dark calm surface, with nothing in it. The main subject is a little smaller in the frame so the whole scene fits in the right part.
